fact: On 13 October 2025 the Minister of Communication installed the ad hoc committee (created by order of 13 December 2024) to draft the national universal access strategy and action plan, so the universal access fund can bring electronic communication services to rural localities still without connectivity.

The World Bank-financed Niger Smart Villages for rural growth and digital inclusion project (P167543), run with the government, aims to increase access to cellphone and broadband services in rural areas, with closing date 23 October 2026.
